prompt: Verify the Muster MCP Bridge capability pack baseline contract.
recordedResponseText:
mcp-bridge capability pack baseline.
Implemented tools: mcp_bridge_setup_plan, mcp_bridge_config_lint, mcp_bridge_install_workflow, mcp_bridge_tool_policy.
Status: native MCP commands own install, OAuth, connection, and execution. The bridge requires explicit auth and readiness, tool allowlists, bounded redacted results, timeout and call limits, per-server failure isolation, and receipts linked to tenant, run, token ledger, and artifacts. Provider-hosted MCPs or skills are reusable only after explicit discovery and approval; credentials are never copied. Customer packs depend on generic identity, policy, secret-store, audit-ledger, provider-host, and artifact-store contracts.
Safety: secret redaction is required and no raw credentials should be printed.
